headings.rules: Must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for sizes > 32px. No 'Inter' for headings. Never exceed text-6xl for main headings.

body.rules: Leading-relaxed for readability. Left-aligned for all dense content.

accent.primary: bg-[#0024D6] (International Klein Blue for critical actions)

colors.rules: Monochrome base. 95% of UI is monochrome. Color exists only to guide action. High contrast text. Use APCA contrast. explicitly set text color on hover. Do not use pure #000000 or #808080.

layouts.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for breathing room. Avoid cramped default paddings.

customer_ui.my_orders_list: Mode A: Bento Grid with wide gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical cards. Left align content.
customer_ui.order_detail: Bento layout. Left side: Order items and tracking timeline (col-span-8). Right side: Payment summary, address, Bill download (col-span-4).
customer_ui.tracking_timeline: Vertical stepped progress with rigid geometric lines (1px solid). Completed steps in Klein Blue, pending in 10% Grey.

admin_ui.order_table: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Dense data layout. Container border-collapse. Subdued borders. Horizontal scrolling.
admin_ui.order_drawer: Slide-out from right (Sheet component). Dense, form-heavy layout. Solid background (no glassmorphism). Sharp 1px borders.
admin_ui.dashboard_grid: Mode B: High Density Grid (gap-4 or gap-6). Summary widgets (col-span-1), Main table (col-span-full).

cards.customer: Flat solid surfaces. 1px subtle border. No soft shadow. Crisp, architectural feel.
cards.admin: Flat solid, rigid. border-r border-b on grid items for technical skeleton look.

buttons.primary: Sharp corners or max 4px radius. High contrast (Black or Klein Blue bg). transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
buttons.secondary: Outline or Ghost, rigid borders. hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-black.

headers.style: Solid Background with a hard bottom border. Never fully transparent.
headers.navigation: Visible links on desktop. Logo on left, links in center/right.

tables.style: Shadcn Table. Custom padding. Header row: uppercase labels, text-xs. Row hover state: slight grey translation.

badges.style: Rectangular, no pill-shapes. 1px solid border matching text color. Example: text-blue-600 border-blue-600 bg-blue-50.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Grid Borders style for Admin (border-collapse, expose skeleton). Flat Solid for Customer app (no glassmorphism to prevent medical/clinical feel, keep it concrete).
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalistic micro-interactions. hover:translate-y-[-2px] on cards. Staggered entrance for list items using framer-motion.
visual_enhancers.textures: Grain/noise overlay on dark areas if any, but primarily rely on crisp typographic contrast.

accessibility.contrast: Normal Text > 4.5:1. Large Text > 3:1. ALWAYS explicitly set hover text color.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Meaningful focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0024D6] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='download-bill-button').

icons.usage: Use Phosphor icons for high-end look.

images.rules: Never use placeholder URLs. Mobile height limit: 80vh.

instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Customer view routes: /my-orders, /my-orders/:id. Admin view routes: /admin/orders.
instructions_to_main_agent.general: Do not center align app containers. Use React (.js) strictly. Ensure robust data tables for Admin and narrative-driven bento details for Customers. Implement Shadcn Dropdown, Table, Sheet, Button, Tabs, Badge.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Use asymmetric bento grids for customer views. Emphasize rigid Swiss typography. NEVER use transition: all. Avoid emoji icons; strictly use Phosphor icons. Provide extensive spacing (p-8, p-12). Incorporate framer-motion for smooth list mounting and detail view expansion. Ensure toast notifications use Sonner.
